targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', rejected_at) AS time, 'customers' AS domain, count(*) AS errors FROM silver.error_customers WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', rejected_at), 'products', count(*) FROM silver.error_products WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', rejected_at), 'purchase_orders', count(*) FROM silver.error_purchase_orders WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', rejected_at), 'product_on_orders', count(*) FROM silver.error_product_on_orders WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', rejected_at), 'invoices', count(*) FROM silver.error_invoices WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', rejected_at), 'inventory_changes', count(*) FROM silver.error_inventory_changes WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', rejected_at), 'truck_fleet', count(*) FROM silver.error_truck_fleet WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', rejected_at), 'truck_positions', count(*) FROM silver.error_truck_positions WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Error rate as % of ingestion volume (last 24h)

targets.rawSql: WITH errors AS (SELECT 'customers' AS domain, count(*) AS error_count FROM silver.error_customers WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '1 day' UNION ALL SELECT 'products', count(*) FROM silver.error_products WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '1 day' UNION ALL SELECT 'purchase_orders', count(*) FROM silver.error_purchase_orders WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '1 day' UNION ALL SELECT 'product_on_orders', count(*) FROM silver.error_product_on_orders WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '1 day' UNION ALL SELECT 'invoices', count(*) FROM silver.error_invoices WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '1 day' UNION ALL SELECT 'inventory_changes', count(*) FROM silver.error_inventory_changes WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '1 day' UNION ALL SELECT 'truck_fleet', count(*) FROM silver.error_truck_fleet WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '1 day' UNION ALL SELECT 'truck_positions', count(*) FROM silver.error_truck_positions WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '1 day'), volume AS (SELECT 'customers' AS domain, count(*) AS event_count FROM iot.customer_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '1 day' UNION ALL SELECT 'products', count(*) FROM iot.product_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '1 day' UNION ALL SELECT 'purchase_orders', count(*) FROM iot.purchase_order_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '1 day' UNION ALL SELECT 'product_on_orders', count(*) FROM iot.product_on_order_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '1 day' UNION ALL SELECT 'invoices', count(*) FROM iot.invoice_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '1 day' UNION ALL SELECT 'inventory_changes', count(*) FROM iot.inventory_changes WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '1 day' UNION ALL SELECT 'truck_fleet', count(*) FROM iot.truck_fleet_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '1 day' UNION ALL SELECT 'truck_positions', count(*) FROM iot.truck_position_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '1 day') SELECT v.domain, e.error_count, v.event_count, round(100.0 * e.error_count / nullif(v.event_count + e.error_count, 0), 2) AS error_rate_pct FROM volume v JOIN errors e ON e.domain = v.domain ORDER BY error_rate_pct DESC

SELECT domain, reason_code, count(*) AS occurrences FROM (SELECT 'customers' AS domain, reason_code FROM silver.error_customers WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '7 days' UNION ALL SELECT 'products', reason_code FROM silver.error_products WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '7 days' UNION ALL SELECT 'purchase_orders', reason_code FROM silver.error_purchase_orders WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '7 days' UNION ALL SELECT 'product_on_orders', reason_code FROM silver.error_product_on_orders WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '7 days' UNION ALL SELECT 'invoices', reason_code FROM silver.error_invoices WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '7 days' UNION ALL SELECT 'inventory_changes', reason_code FROM silver.error_inventory_changes WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '7 days' UNION ALL SELECT 'truck_fleet', reason_code FROM silver.error_truck_fleet WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '7 days' UNION ALL SELECT 'truck_positions', reason_code FROM silver.error_truck_positions WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '7 days') t GROUP BY domain, reason_code ORDER BY occurrences DESC LIMIT 20
